title: Deterministic execution of the Goldreich–Levin learner
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let the learning input specify a dimension $n$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean target. Running the deterministic Goldreich–Levin learning program with target $f$ has the point-mass law at the output and cost returned by executing its corresponding deterministic query program with oracle $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic Goldreich–Levin learning input, including its specified dimension
A Boolean target function on the sign cube of that dimension
